title: nolana obtusa
intro: Nolana obtusa, commonly known as the Chilean shrub, is a plant species that belongs to the Four O'Clock family (Nyctaginaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nolana obtusa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Nolana obtusa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
